notes:
Kadget Remote for Android — control your Mac running Kadget from your phone over Tailscale.

Install: download the APK on the phone and allow installing from this source. Then on the Mac open Kadget › Tools › Kadget Remote, turn it on and scan the code.

## Changes

- fix: dock tells the Mac when it stops watching toggles; tool list fits the smallest window and long Turkish titles; wallpaper goldens top-aligned
- fix(remote-app): clips refresh on finger-up, not under a press; Last clip paste refusals show on the dock; asking says to paste again; paste waits for a question; goldens for the failure banner and the Open editor
- docs(remote): a paste never waits, so its refusals are asking or unattended; notch radii golden
- fix(remote-app): one glow on Home in landscape; radii 12/pill only; every overline upper-cases the Turkish way; dock turn logic in providers; dock leave assumption documented
- fix(remote-app): clipboard history stays fresh on an open dock; Paste on Mac says the Mac's refusal; capabilities re-read on access.changed
- fix(remote-app): Open keys take only http(s) (https:// added), say why they fail; app picker searched, no lookups in the editor; Follow system never keeps Açık in the dark
- fix(remote): clipboard.paste asks like screen control; actions.state watch:false; info.changed on the history switch
- feat(clipboard): picture previews, a bigger panel with tighter rows; pictures on the phone too
- style: const knob shape (phone)
- fix(remote): dock review: the notch takes the latest Now Playing when it joins a phone's stream, elapsed is sent as of now, new action ids reach phones, dark mode published when changed elsewhere
- fix(neu): crisp switches: an accent-filled well uses accent edges, the knob on it a tight shadow
- fix(remote-app): dock mode needs the Mac's actions switch too (its methods ride on it)
- fix(remote-app): Now playing fits three-row pages, Stats shows CPU and GPU temperatures, a paste refused as declined asks for Accessibility, the dock never blanks unless it is closing; goldens at the board's 1:47
- feat(remote): action states for the dock's toggle keys, Quick toggles with a state in the catalog, dock protocol docs
- chore(remote-app): drop unused dock strings and the Coming soon note
- feat(remote-app): the dock (Desk, Music, Stats, Clipboard, edit mode with the widget library and key editor), Home's Dock button and page, the rotate banner, Customize › Deck, Settings › Dock; goldens at 844 × 390
- feat(remote-app): dock protocol client (now playing with local elapsed, artwork, media volume and seek, clipboard paste, action states, deck capability), layout store per Mac, dock session with dimming, dock settings
- feat(remote-app): deck models and pure logic (grid placement, layout JSON with migration, export, pages, idle dim, now playing interpolation, network history, dock entry)
- fix(remote-app): Deck inert with Coming soon, no paging after a failure, no copy without the item's text, thumbnail decode fallback, Turkish fits
- feat(remote): clipboard.history, clipboard.item, clipboard.copy on the Mac; per-phone permission; stats sensor fields
- feat(remote-app): Kadget Remote 1.6.0; goldens for Home with the nav bar, Customize, clipboard history and stats sensors
- feat(remote-app): the Mac's shell with the pinned nav bar, Home tiles, Customize, clipboard history and stats sensors screens, hold-to-run keys
- feat(remote-app): read the optional GPU, temperature, fan and per-core stats
- feat(remote-app): clipboard history client (paged, filtered, thumbnails cached) with a fallback for older Macs
- feat(remote-app): pinned pages, per-Mac action layout with a pure reconciler, hold to run
- feat(remote-app): every upgraded phone follows the system appearance
- chore: drop committed golden failure images; ignore them
- fix(remote-app): whole-pill field taps, sliders that ignore scrolls, overlay on the ground
- feat(remote-app): page insets, file browser panel, goldens and component tests
- feat(remote-app): neumorphic theme, settings migration and components on kadget_neu
- chore: both apps depend on packages/kadget_neu
